purpose: Outlet semantic labels (mesh zone id -> out-le/out-li/out-ri/out-re) that the v5.1/v5.2 datasets used for these units. They came from the legacy qs-smooth-v3 boundary manifest (data_wss_pinn/volume_uvwp_peak_qs_smooth_v3_*/cases/*/manifest.json, since removed), which crosses the operator's UDF keys on one side for exactly these 4 units (all 265 v5.2p4 units checked: no other differs). outlet_semantics() uses this table before the UDF fallback so a rebuild reproduces the dataset naming (feature inputs such as wall_semantic_id and the capfit flow features stay as in v5.2). The CFD boundary conditions do not depend on these names (protocol RCR = f(area of the face each UDF thread points at)).
source: topology audit reports used by the v5.2 build (audits/topology/_stale_20260930_labelfix/)
